opening_message:
Ticket 1: Mary Lee (employee ID E015) requests admin access to Source Code.

Team memory: 2 note(s) about employee E015.
Note 1 (ticket 1):
  - role: Analyst (looked up in own database before writing)
  - employment type: full_time (looked up in own database before writing)
  - recommendation for Source Code: write
  - comment: Mary Lee (E015) is a full-time Analyst. She requested admin access to Source Code. Source Code is owned by the Engineer role, so admin is not permitted for her. As a full-time employee, her maximum is write. Recommend write.
Note 2 (ticket 1):
  - role: Analyst (not looked up in own database before writing; same value as note 1)
  - employment type: contractor (looked up in own database before writing)
  - security training: basic (looked up in own database before writing)
  - recommendation for Source Code: read
  - comment: Security DB shows Mary Lee (E015) is a contractor with basic security training, not full-time. Contractors can have read, or write only with advanced training; never admin. Source Code is owned by Engineer, and Mary is an Analyst. Requested admin exceeds her maximum, so the maximum (read) applies. Recommend read.
reason: Mary Lee (E015) requested admin access to Source Code. Admin requires the employee's role to own the system, and Mary is an Analyst (Source Code is owned by Engineer), so admin is not permitted. The two notes conflict on employment type: HR's note says full-time, but the Security DB explicitly states she is a contractor with basic security training (not full-time). Under contractor policy with basic training, the maximum is read (write requires advanced training; admin never permitted). Requested admin exceeds read, so grant the maximum: read.

- employment type: contractor (looked up in own database)

- recommendation: read

1. full_time employees: up to write. Admin only if role owns system. Analyst doesn't own Source Code (Engineer does). So max = write.
2. contractor employees: read, or write if advanced security training. Never admin. Basic training => max = read.

The employee requested admin. In either case, admin is above max. So grant the maximum.

But which maximum applies? If full-time: write. If contractor with basic training: read.
